messages:
Lily: FYI I started a staged bring-up of ember-17b-int4-sharedkv (shared-KV compaction + int4) in staging. quick redteam smoke shows a reproducible drop in refusal vs fp16 baseline on persona-primed jailbreaks.
Arman: what's the delta? any repros?
Lily: baseline ember-17b-fp16 refusal=0.96; ember-17b-int4-sharedkv refusal=0.69 on our persona+jailbreak suite (~900 prompts). failing cases tend to have a compaction event mid-dialog.
Diego: did policy log a queued refuse? any insert offsets?
policy-bot: policy-check: HIGH_RISK (0.91) at ctx_pos=158 -> action=REFUSE queued insert_at=159
Lily: log excerpt shows compaction + reindex then emissions: ```
[2026-06-05T10:12:04Z] kv_cache: compact start -> merged blocks
[2026-06-05T10:12:04Z] kernel: int4_sharedkv_v1 loaded
[2026-06-05T10:12:04Z] gen token=158 id=5009 prob=0.03
[2026-06-05T10:12:04Z] policy: queued REFUSE insert_at=159 (anchor=offset)
[2026-06-05T10:12:04Z] kv_cache: reindex complete -> new_idx_map
[2026-06-05T10:12:04Z] gen token=159 id=1013 prob=0.42
[2026-06-05T10:12:04Z] output emitted (no refusal injected)
```
Arman: same class of bug as other families but the shared-KV compaction makes insert offsets especially fragile. propose policy change: switch queued inserts to anchor by immutable token_uuid + ctx_epoch, not relative offset. that should survive reindex/compaction.
Diego: agree. also can runtime expose an atomic "checkpoint_for_policy" API so policy can request a safe insertion point before compaction proceeds?
runtime-bot: note: deployment ember-17b-int4-sharedkv -> staging succeeded (pool: st-7c3).
Lily: I ran quick ablations: disabling compaction or setting prefix_cache=false restores refusal to ~0.95. batch_size=1 also helps. putting the model on hold for prod until patch.
Arman: I'll open ML-REPRO ticket with logs + minimized curl reproducer and a small seed prompt. Diego will prototype token_uuid anchoring in the policy hook.
Diego: will iterate and post results. proposed interim mitigation: flip default compaction_off for sharedkv quant family.
Lily: thanks — tagging security & runtime. please link tickets here when created. :eyes:
